instruction: Please insert three blank pages at the beginning of this document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires inserting three page breaks (three blank pages) at the beginning. Original document has 4 page breaks. After adding 3 more, total should be 7. Uses existing contains_page_break metric.

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator only checks the total count of page breaks (7) but does not verify that they were inserted at the beginning of the document
The instruction explicitly requires inserting pages 'at the beginning', but the metric function 'contains_page_break' has no position awareness
The evaluator would incorrectly pass if page breaks were added anywhere in the document (beginning, middle, or end) as long as the total count is 7
This is a significant semantic verification gap that allows incorrect completions to pass
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify the evaluator to check that the first 3 paragraphs/sections contain page breaks, or verify position-specific page break placement
Alternative: Create a new metric function that checks page break positions relative to document structure
Alternative: Use a more sophisticated metric that counts page breaks only in the first N paragraphs/runs to ensure they are at the beginning
Consider verifying the page count (should increase by 3) as an additional check alongside position verification
